page_title: MON 3-1 HAV | Monaco v Le Havre 16/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's it for today, Ruddy Buquet has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+9' The ball falls to Godson Kyeremeh (Le Havre) on the edge of the box, but his shot goes well wide of the goal.
90+9' Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
90+8' Le Havre take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. Le Havre force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
90+8' Fantastic run and shot from mid-range by Ally Samatta (Le Havre), but a defender denies him an almost certain goal by getting his body in the way. Le Havre have been awarded a corner kick.
90+6' Paris Brunner (Monaco) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Ruddy Buquet saw the whole situation.
90+5' The game is interrupted as Paris Brunner (Monaco) is flagged offside.
90+3' Monaco keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
90' There will be a minimum of 8 min. of added time.
89' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Aladji Bamba (Monaco) comes onto the pitch so that Aleksandr Golovin can be given a rest.
89' A yellow card for a tackle by Gautier Lloris (Le Havre). Ruddy Buquet doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
86' Vanderson (Monaco) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
83' Ally Samatta (Le Havre) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar.
81' Here is a change. Takumi Minamino is going off and Adi Hutter gives the last tactical orders to George Ilenikhena (Monaco).
80' That's the end of the game for Mika Biereth, who is replaced by Paris Brunner (Monaco).

80' Lukas Hradecky makes a brilliant save! Felix Mambimbi (Le Havre) easily weaves through the defence and fires the ball from mid-range. His low shot goes towards the middle of the goal but is saved by the keeper!
79' A substitution has been made. Rassoul Ndiaye is replaced by Daren Nbenbege Mosengo (Le Havre).
78' Serge Costa has decided to make a change. Felix Mambimbi (Le Havre) replaces Etienne Youte Kinkoue.
78' Arouna Sangante is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Godson Kyeremeh (Le Havre).
75' Arouna Sangante (Le Havre) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.

74' 3 - 1 It's a goal! Denis Zakaria plays a lovely pass into the box and finds Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco). He tries his luck from close range and coolly strikes the ball into the back of the net. 3:1.
73' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
70' The ball possession at the moment is 76:24.
67' 2 - 1 Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Lukas Hradecky with a strike into the bottom right corner. He makes it 2:1.
67' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) is penalised for a foul. Ruddy Buquet had a clear view and blows his whistle.
66' Arouna Sangante (Le Havre) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
65' Arouna Sangante (Le Havre) picks up an injury.
63' Adi Hutter prepares a substitution. Lamine Camara is replaced by Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco).
63' Here comes a substitution. Vanderson (Monaco) is brought on as a substitute for Jordan Teze.
61' 2 - 0 Gooal! Lamine Camara takes over corner duties. Eric Dier (Monaco) gets his head on the ball from the corner and puts it low into the middle of the net. 2:0.
61' The referee awards a corner and Lamine Camara (Monaco) goes over to take it.
60' Gautier Lloris (Le Havre) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
58' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Fode Doucoure (Le Havre) replaces Younes Namli.
58' Serge Costa has decided to substitute Simon Ebonog and he is replaced by Ally Samatta (Le Havre).
55' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Mory Diaw, who smothers the ball.
53' Simon Ebonog (Le Havre) makes a strong challenge and Ruddy Buquet blows for a foul.
50' Dangerous play by Arouna Sangante (Le Havre). Ruddy Buquet blows his whistle for a foul.
49' Lamine Camara (Monaco) takes the free kick from mid-range, but he balloons his effort high over the bar. What a miskick!
49' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
48' Jordan Teze (Monaco) creates a yard of space for himself and tries an effort from distance, but it's blocked.
48' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
48' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Ruddy Buquet blows his whistle for a foul.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+3' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) squanders a big chance. He takes a rebound inside the box and smashes the ball against the right post!
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
45' Poor challenge! Simon Ebonog (Le Havre) is penalised for tripping and Ruddy Buquet blows his whistle.
43' Some great controlled play and passing from Monaco. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.

41' Younes Namli (Le Havre) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
40' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 4:1.
38' Caio Henrique (Monaco) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.

37' Caio Henrique (Monaco) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Monaco will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
36' The corner by Lamine Camara (Monaco) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.
33' Half-chance! Mika Biereth (Monaco) plays a pass into the box, but Mory Diaw reacts well to snuff out the attack.
32' Simon Ebonog (Le Havre) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
32' 1 - 0 An unfortunate own goal is conceded by Gautier Lloris (Le Havre), who attempted to block the ball after a cross, but instead he sends it under his own crossbar.
31' Simon Ebonog (Le Havre) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
31' Lamine Camara (Monaco) picks up a loose pass and unexpectedly unleashes a howitzer from distance, but the effort comes to nothing as a defender gets in the block.
29' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) takes a short corner kick.
28' Younes Namli (Le Havre) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Ruddy Buquet stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
26' The resulting corner from Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) comes to nothing.
25' Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. The ball goes out of play. Le Havre are awarded a corner kick.
25' Lamine Camara (Monaco) is able to continue to play.
22' Looks like Lamine Camara (Monaco) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
21' The percentage of ball possession is – 76:24.
19' Christian Mawissa (Monaco) makes a rough challenge and Ruddy Buquet blows his whistle for a foul.
18' Mika Biereth (Monaco) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but he misses the left post by a whisker.
18' Flag goes up against Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
16' Flag up against Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
15' Caio Henrique (Monaco) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
12' Lamine Camara (Monaco) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
12' Jordan Teze (Monaco) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Monaco have a corner.
11' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range low towards the middle of the goal, but Mory Diaw is equal to it and makes an easy save.
9' Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
8' Monaco are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
4' Good chance for Jordan Teze (Monaco) as he latched on to a cross on the edge of the box and blasted the ball towards the net! It flew wide of the right post.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Monaco will kick-off.
Ruddy Buquet will officiate today.
